identified_as: Unionville High School, Kennett Square
era: Nickname was Indians for 60+ years before switching to Longhorns (recent); colours blue and gold unchanged as far as found.
notes: Wikipedia infobox has no colours. Search snippets: PAPrepLive 'blue and gold', MaxPreps 'Midnight Blue, Gold', EliteProspects 'Navy + Gold' -- blue is a dark/navy shade.
evidence: Unionville HS site (uhs.ucfsd.org) favicon: navy #012147 longhorn head with gold horn tips; district/HS site theme CSS navy #061D8E/#04081A and gold #FEBD35. District UCF footer logo is white-only. Blue is a dark navy, agrees with first-pass 'midnight blue/navy and gold'.

identified_as: Technical Memorial High School, Erie (closed 1993)
era: Merged with Academy HS after 1992-93 to form Central HS (later Central Tech, black and gold, Falcons; now Erie High, purple and gold, Royals). Tech Memorial's own colours not found.
notes: Do not use successor colours. One search snippet called the Centaur the old Tech Memorial mascot; unverified.
evidence: No image or page for the closed school found (search engines returned unrelated results); nothing looked at shows its colours.

identified_as: Halifax Area High School, Halifax

evidence: Halifax Area SD site (hasd.us): wildcat head logo is black on white only; site theme CSS main brand colour #CBB778 (Vegas gold, 149 uses) plus black. Agrees with Wikipedia 'black and Vegas gold'.

identified_as: Youngsville Middle/High School, Youngsville (Warren County)

evidence: Times Observer Feb 2025 photos: Youngsville gym wall painted red with white 'YOUNGSVILLE EAGLES' lettering (wall red sampled #9F2619 in photo lighting, approximate); home uniforms white with red trim, away uniforms black with red. Agrees with Wikipedia red and white. Warren County SD site has no Youngsville logo (school page behind a bot check).
